# mlr3hf

Package website: [release](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/) \|
[dev](https://mlr-org.r-universe.dev/mlr3hf)

Integration of [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co) datasets with the
[`mlr3`](https://mlr3.mlr-org.com/) ecosystem.

## What is `mlr3hf`?

[Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/) provides a large collection of
datasets for machine learning and data science. `mlr3hf` connects these
datasets with the [`mlr3`](https://mlr3.mlr-org.com/) ecosystem.

Datasets can be downloaded from Hugging Face and converted into `mlr3`
data backends and tasks.

`mlr3hf` supports both Parquet datasets generated by Hugging Face and
the original dataset files stored in a repository.

## Installation

Install the last release from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("mlr3hf")
```

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

pak::pak("mlr-org/mlr3hf")
```

## Example

### Loading a Hugging Face dataset

[`hfdt()`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/hfdt.md) creates
an `HFData` object representing a Hugging Face dataset. The object
provides access to the dataset and its metadata and can be converted
into an [`mlr3::Task`](https://mlr3.mlr-org.com/reference/Task.html).

``` r

hf_data = hfdt(
  repo_id = "scikit-learn/iris",
  config = "default",
  target = "Species",
  task_type = "classif"
)

hf_data
#> <HFData:scikit-learn/iris> (150x7)
#>  * Storage: 5.06 MB - This storage is for the whole repository, not for a single file or config
```

### Creating an `mlr3` Task

The `HFData` object can be converted into an
[`mlr3::Task`](https://mlr3.mlr-org.com/reference/Task.html).

``` r

task = as_task(hf_data)
task
#> 
#> ── <TaskClassif> (150x6) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Target: Species
#> • Target classes: Iris-setosa (33%), Iris-versicolor (33%), Iris-virginica (33%)
#> • Properties: multiclass
#> • Features (5):
#>   • dbl (5): Id, PetalLengthCm, PetalWidthCm, SepalLengthCm, SepalWidthCm
```

### Basic train + predict

The resulting task can be used with the `mlr3` ecosystem in the same way
as other `mlr3` tasks.

``` r

learner = lrn("classif.rpart")

split = partition(task, ratio = 0.67)

learner$train(task, split$train_set)

prediction = learner$predict(task, split$test_set)

prediction$score(msr("classif.acc"))
#> classif.acc 
#>           1
```

### Resample

The task can also be used directly with `mlr3` resampling strategies.

``` r

resampling = rsmp("cv", folds = 3L)

rr = resample(task, learner, resampling)

rr$aggregate()
#> classif.ce 
#>          0
```

### Direct task construction

For workflows where the intermediate `HFData` object is not required,
`tsk()` can be used to construct an
[`mlr3::Task`](https://mlr3.mlr-org.com/reference/Task.html) directly.

``` r

task = tsk(
  "hf",
  repo_id = "scikit-learn/iris",
  config = "default",
  target = "Species",
  task_type = "classif"
)

task
#> 
#> ── <TaskClassif> (150x6) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Target: Species
#> • Target classes: Iris-setosa (33%), Iris-versicolor (33%), Iris-virginica (33%)
#> • Properties: multiclass
#> • Features (5):
#>   • dbl (5): Id, PetalLengthCm, PetalWidthCm, SepalLengthCm, SepalWidthCm
```

## Documentation

The [package documentation](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/) contains
the complete documentation and examples for `mlr3hf`.

For more information about the `mlr3` ecosystem, see the [`mlr3`
book](https://mlr3book.mlr-org.com/).

## Extension Packages

`mlr3hf` is part of the `mlr3` ecosystem and can be used together with
the many extension packages available for `mlr3`.

For example, `mlr3learners` provides learners that can be used with
tasks created by `mlr3hf`.

See the [mlr3 ecosystem](https://mlr-org.com/ecosystem.html) for a
complete list of extension packages.

## Contributing to `mlr3hf`

`mlr3hf` is a free and open source software.

If you encounter problems using the package, find missing or misleading
documentation, or want to suggest a feature, please open an issue in the
[issue tracker](https://github.com/mlr-org/mlr3hf/issues).

Pull requests are welcome and will be included at the discretion of the
maintainers.

Please consult the [mlr3 wiki](https://github.com/mlr-org/mlr3/wiki/)
for development and contribution guidelines.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`HFData`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/HFData.md) :
  Hugging Face Dataset Wrapper
- [`as_data_backend(`*`<HFData>`*`)`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/as_data_backend.HFData.md)
  : Coerce an HFData Object to an mlr3 Data Backend
- [`as_task(`*`<HFData>`*`)`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/as_task.HFData.md)
  : Coerce an HFData Object to an mlr3 Task
- [`cache_hfhub()`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/cache_hfhub.md)
  : Cache a File from a Hugging Face Hub Repository
- [`cache_parquet()`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/cache_parquet.md)
  : Cache a Parquet Export of a Hugging Face Dataset
- [`download_desc()`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/download_desc.md)
  : download_desc
- [`fetch_dataset_meta()`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/fetch_dataset_meta.md)
  : Fetch nrows/ncols for a vector of dataset ids concurrently via
  curl's multi-handle pool.
- [`hfdt()`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/hfdt.md) :
  Create an HFData object from a Hugging Face dataset
- [`list_datasets()`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/list_datasets.md)
  : List Datasets from Hugging Face Hub
- [`mlr3hf-package`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/mlr3hf.md)
  [`mlr3hf`](https://mlr-org.github.io/mlr3hf/reference/mlr3hf.md) :
  mlr3hf: Hugging Face datasets for mlr3
